items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I knew him, but I'd have left his bum with him because he played piano nicely.

ctx.x: What the hell? Lawrence and all of them when he was living with them. He was well known for 27th. And Pichu, well I knew him, but I'd have left his bum with him because he played piano nicely.
Walter Pichon, he's a nice piano player.
